body: Closes #6644 ## Summary Adds two in-place surfaces for editing environment variables, extending approach 3 from the issue: - **Quick Peek popover**: non-secret current values are editable in the Global variables section and for the active personal, team, or global environment. - **Environments sidebar tab**: clicking an environment name opens an editor view in the sidebar, with an editable key and current value per variable and a back button to return to the list. Edits write directly to `CurrentValueService` / `SecretEnvironmentService`, so the next request resolves the new value. Quick Peek: ![quick peek current value editing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/safwanyp/hoppscotch/assets/issue-6644/quick-peek.gif) Sidebar editor: ![sidebar environment editor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/safwanyp/hoppscotch/assets/issue-6644/sidebar-editor.gif) ## Implementation - `CurrentValueService.setEnvironmentVariableValue`: single-row `Map.set` update instead of replacing the whole array. The optional key seeds a missing entry so the cleanup watcher keeps it. - `CurrentValueService.setEnvironmentVariableKey` and `SecretEnvironmentService.setSecretEnvironmentVariableValue` / `setSecretEnvironmentVariableKey`: keep key-based lookups resolving after a rename, and let secrets be edited locally. - `CurrentValueInput.vue`: a writable computed over the service, no local shadow state. - `Editor.vue`: the sidebar editor. Values auto-save on input; keys commit on blur/Enter. Secret values stay masked with a reveal toggle. - `Selector.vue`: renders the inline current-value inputs for non-secret rows. - Environment rows emit a new `open-environment` event; the sidebar tab swaps between the list and the editor. - Adds the `action.back` string and unit tests for the new service methods. ## Verification ### Automated checks | Check | Result | | --- | --- | | `pnpm --filter @hoppscotch/common test` | 1,210 passed, 2 skipped | | `pnpm --filter @hoppscotch/common prod-lint` | 0 errors, 142 warnings (pre-existing) | | `pnpm --filter @hoppscotch/common do-typecheck` | passed | ### Browser checks - Quick Peek: personal and global current-value edits updated the service and persisted state; changing `base_url` to `https://echo.hoppscotch.io` made `GET <>/get` hit the updated URL; secrets stayed masked; Escape closed the popover. - Sidebar editor: clicking an environment name opened the editor, and editing a current value plus revealing and editing a secret value applied in the UI (shown in the GIF above). --- ## Summary by cubic Implements approach 3 from #6644. Non-secret current values are now editable inline in the Environment Quick Peek popover (Global and active environment sections), and clicking an environment name opens a sidebar editor where variable keys, current values, and secrets can be edited. Previously read-only, edits write straight to `CurrentValueService` / `SecretEnvironmentService`, so the next request resolves the new value. - Adds single-row value and key setters to `CurrentValueService` and `SecretEnvironmentService`, plus unit tests. - The editor closes on workspace switch and strips client-local values before writing definitions. - Team key edits are serialized, and a failed save only reverts the rename it was sent for. - Environment names are now buttons, making the editor keyboard-reachable. - Value edits for keyless variables are ignored because the value stores drop empty-key entries. - Inputs carry per-variable accessible labels; initial values stay read-only in Quick Peek, secrets are masked until revealed, and team viewers can edit local current values but keys stay locked. Written for commit 64ba4ff75eff7bef868b010947f50e9b6b326540. Summary will update on new commits.
title: feat(common): edit environment values from quick peek and the sidebar
